Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Maine: Obscenity referendum to ban items of a sexual nature defeated 2. Massachusetts: Bill passed assuring privacy protection for HTLVIII positive persons COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse Sale 3. Interview with John Glines, discussing Stamp Out AIDS Project 4. Missouri: Anti-gay lawmaker fails in an attempt to ban gays from teaching in schools 5. Andy Humm discusses the 17th Anniversary of the Stonewall riots COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 6. Mayor Edward Koch attacked by homophobe at the Proclamation for Lesbian and Gay Pride Week, with clip 7. Adair Films loses its contract to make an AIDS documentary to a non-gay company COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 8. Hawaii: Governor signs measure ensuring confidentiality of those testing positive for sexually transmitted diseases 9. Lesbians at high risk for discrimination following the AIDS epidemic, despite being at lowest risk for the disease 10. Call for volunteers for a national study of drug treatments to treat AIDS/HTLVIII positive persons 11. Researchers grow AIDS virus in animal cells for the first time 12. Announcements about Gay Pride Weekend COMMERCIAL: New York City Gay Men's Chorus 13. Sports Report 14. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Psychotherapist Michael Shernoff discussing eroticizing safer sex 15. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Coverage of the Cincinnati Gay Pride Parade, includes clips of the march, the mayor reading equal rights amendment, GCN ensemble singing "Steppin' Out" COMMERCIAL: New York City Gay Men's Chorus 2. Interview with David Summers, cabaret singer and AIDS activist, regarding "Hero of My Own Life," with clip COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" magazine 3. Announcement of "Ten By Tennessee" production of Tennessee Williams' plays 4. Closing credits
